title: Best Data Typing Services (2026): Accurate Typing from Any Source
description: How to hire a data typist to type scanned documents, handwritten notes, images or PDFs into editable text: accuracy, privacy, how to brief it and red flags.
intro: Data typists convert scanned pages, handwritten notes, images, receipts and PDFs into editable text or spreadsheets. It is useful when automatic text recognition fails, such as with messy handwriting, poor scans or mixed layouts. Good typing is accurate, consistent and follows your formatting rules. Jobs go wrong when instructions are vague, accuracy is not checked, or private documents are shared carelessly. This guide helps you get clean typed data you can trust.

faq.q: Is typing done by hand or by software?
faq.a: Often software first, then manual correction, or fully manual for difficult sources. Ask which method is used.
Agree on an accuracy target and spot-check samples. Difficult handwriting may include unclear words, which should be marked.
Word, Google Docs, Excel, Google Sheets or plain text.
Share only what is needed, remove sensitive details where possible and agree on deletion.
Often per page, per entry or per hour, depending on difficulty.
